title: Texas offers $100 for invasive black carp caught near state waters
summary_full: Texas offers a hundred-dollar bounty for each invasive black carp caught. This program aims to improve understanding of the species spreading through river systems. Participants can receive up to ten reimbursements monthly for collected specimens. Research focuses on the fish's age, growth, and distribution patterns. Black carp pose a threat to native freshwater mussels and snails.
